speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe when the rash, numbness, and tingling first began and if they appear simultaneously? I also need to know if you have any history of liver disease, recent travel, or exposure to insects or animals.

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any itching that worsens at night, and have you observed any burrows or small bumps on the webs of your fingers, wrists, or elbows? I would also like to examine your hands closely for any signs of linear tracks.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Skin scraping of hypopigmented macules for acid-fast bacilli.
The combination of hypopigmented macules with loss of sensation, madarosis, and eyebrow thinning is highly suggestive of leprosy.
